findings.title: Disposal into a cut-off cavity

findings.reader_payoff: The well becomes an operative form of disposal, so the scene is read as a designed change of Joseph's visibility and social location rather than as scenery around the plot.
findings.containment: The finding preserves the literal placement in the well. It does not claim that death is enacted, that recovery is certain, or that every hidden-place sense is active.
